verdict.rationale: Docs confirm 'tiered autonomy' in droid exec that controls which operations run without manual confirmation, directly supporting configurable auto-approval, but there's no detail on granularity (e.g., an explicit 'auto-approve all' flag/mode) or independent confirmation of behavior. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a full auto-approve-all setting/flag, independent/hands-on verification of the autonomy tiers in practice.
